title: Juicy Egyptian Mung Bean Sprouts Fritters
description: A silky, umami-packed fritter that energizes with every bite, served wrapped in airy ti leaves.
instructions: Rinse the mung bean sprouts and pat them dry.
In a bowl, whisk together chickpea flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, cumin, coriander, and sumac.
Add tomato paste, water, and the egg to the dry mixture, whisking until a smooth batter forms.
Gently fold in the mung bean sprouts, ensuring they are evenly coated.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 180°C for agemono-style deep frying.
Drop spoonfuls of the batter-coated sprouts into the hot oil, frying in batches.
Cook each fritter for 2-3 minutes, or until golden and crispy, turning halfway through.
Remove the fritters with a slotted spoon and place them on paper towels to drain excess oil.
Lay ti leaf wrappers flat and spoon a few fritters onto each leaf.
Fold the ti leaf around the fritters and serve immediately while hot.
